name: Advanced Books
description: Advanced book and comic features for Jellyfin 12, including Komga-compatible One-Shots and an Advanced Reader.
overview: Komga-compatible book handling and an advanced comic reader for Jellyfin.

versions.changelog: Add dedicated two-finger pinch-to-zoom for paged Advanced Reader modes. Pinch gestures render a smooth live preview, suppress accidental page-turn swipes, and commit the final zoom through the reader's existing controls so persisted per-user zoom stays synchronized.
